title: Permissions Sankey and Quick-Review Cards — Console Audit & Cost Lens
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a compact, scannable Permissions Sankey visualization paired with contextual Quick-Review Cards for the Redwood Console Audit and Cost views. The goal is to help workspace admins rapidly identify high-cost permission paths, surface transient/granted access, and offer one-click remediation or review actions. The Sankey highlights flows from roles -> principals -> resources with tokenized cost attribution, while cards give action affordances (revoke, request justification, start access review). Focus on minimal cognitive load for on-call and compliance reviewers while preserving drill-down fidelity for platform teams.
acceptance_criteria: Sankey shows top 10 permission flows and aggregates the rest into 'Other'
Hovering a flow reveals tokenized cost estimate and most-recent-grant event
Quick-Review Card exposes primary action buttons (Revoke, Request Justification, Start Review) and an expandable timeline
Design spec includes responsive states for narrow consoles and maintains accessibility contrast ratios
Prototype linked in Figma demonstrates both the Audit timeline drilldown and the Cost attribution toggle
